title: Ingredient
description:
An alchemical reagent. Its effects are ids drawn from the shared effect registry (data/effects); brewing combines ingredients that share an effect to produce a potion or poison.

Some ingredients are condensed essences or spirit cores used primarily for character advancement (breakthroughs) and alchemical refining rather than direct consumption. These carry a Wuxing phase and qualityGrade to determine their potency and elemental affinity.

effects.description: Effect ids this ingredient can impart (must have 'ingredient' in their channels). For normal reagents, magnitude/duration are derived at brew time from Alchemy skill. For spirit cores and essences, effects are typically marker effects (e.g. essence_fire) used to identify the core's nature during refinement or breakthrough resolution.

phase.description: The Wuxing elemental phase of this essence or spirit core. Determines affinity and how it interacts with other phased essences via the cycles in data/wuxing when used for breakthroughs or refining.

qualityGrade.description: The quality grade of the essence. Higher grades yield significantly stronger bonuses when consumed in a breakthrough or used as a refining component. This is the primary power ladder for advancement essences (distinct from the simpler 'rarity' field).
